candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, resetPassword only sets the new password and calls usersService.update. It never deletes the user's sessions (sessionService.deleteByUserId is never called here). The already signed-in phone's session row stays valid, so its refresh token still passes AuthService.refreshToken (updateByHash finds the session) and the phone can renew its login. By contrast, AuthService.update deletes other sessions when the password changes (line ~469), but the reset path has no equivalent.

fix.description: In resetPassword, after the password update succeeds, call `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });` so every session is revoked and no refresh token can be renewed.
